Maya (CS): :wave: Hey team — kicking off Orbiton onboarding handoff. Quick agenda: confirm stakeholders, baseline success criteria, 30/60/90 timeline, enablement sessions, and any renewal or compliance flags.
Liam (AM): Hi Maya — thanks. Kara from Orbiton is on the thread for PM context. Primary goal is live in prod with Redwood Hosted by end of month.
Kara (Orbiton PM): Thanks — correct. Key must-haves: SSO via SAML, data retention controls, and embeddings for search. We also need an internal demo for execs in week 2.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll own SSO + KMS integration plan. Quick Q: do they want Private (VPC) or Hosted initially? Kara: Hosted to start, but must be able to pivot to Private within 8 weeks if compliance requires.
Noah (Eng): From runtime side we'll allocate a dedicated test pool for their ingest load. Can we get sample traffic profile and average sequence length?
Kara (Orbiton PM): I'll upload a sample token histogram and a redacted dataset to the shared drive today. Also pinging security: they need proof of encryption-at-rest and audit logs.
Maya (CS): Success criteria (suggested):
• Prod inference under 200ms p50 for queries <512 tokens
• 99.5% request success rate for a 72h smoke window
• Exec demo with canned prompts + live Q&A
• Enablement: 2 workshops (dev and ops) + runbook handed off
Liam (AM): Add renewal risk note: customer has a vendor review at 90 days. If we miss exec demo or SSO by then, risk of delay. Marking RISK_HIGH for internal tracking.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): Proposed timeline:
Week 0 (this week): SSO initiation, sample data ingested to staging, initial perf tests
Week 1: Enablement workshop #1 (dev), analytics setup, KV/prefix caching config
Week 2: Exec demo dry run + prod deploy window planning
Week 3-4: Monitoring SLO ramp, A/B routing if needed, enablement #2 (ops)
Week 8: Private deployment readiness checkpoint (if requested)
Kara (Orbiton PM): That timeline looks good. Can we put concrete dates once I confirm their blackout windows?
Maya (CS): Yes — Kara please confirm blackout windows by EOD Thu. Also items owner mapping:
• SSO & KMS: Arjun
• Perf & Test Pool: Noah
• Exec Demo & Success Criteria: Kara + Liam
• Runbook & Enablement: Maya
• Compliance docs: Liam
deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted a message: "staging cluster created for account orbiton — id: rwd-stg-027"
Noah (Eng): I'll spin up an instrumented instance and share a short runbook snippet. Will also add alert thresholds for token-rate spikes.
Kara (Orbiton PM): One more ask — they want a lightweight feedback loop after week 1: 15-min check-ins thrice a week for the first 2 weeks. Is that feasible?
Maya (CS): Feasible. I'll calendar 15-min standups Mon/Wed/Fri for first 2 weeks — invite will go out after Kara confirms participants.
Liam (AM): I'll prepare renewal-risk mitigation plan: exec deck + TCO comparison vs their incumbent.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): For traceability, I'll drop a short checklist in the shared Google doc: SAML metadata, cert thumbprints, KMS key ARN, data pipeline endpoints. Kara: please add contact for their infra lead.
Kara (Orbiton PM): Added infra lead: sam.lee@orbiton.com. Also flagged regulatory point: they need SOC/ISO attestation doc — Liam can you share the package?
Liam (AM): On it. Sharing doc link in the channel after this thread.
Maya (CS): Great — next steps: Kara confirm blackout windows + infra contact done; Arjun start SSO setup; Noah start perf pool; I'll schedule enablement sessions. We'll reconvene Thu 11am PT for a checkpoint.
Kara (Orbiton PM): Confirmed — blackout windows are Tue/Wed next week. See you Thu 11am PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
